The '''Under Split''' was a tactical maneuver used during [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]]. While dangerous for the lead [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], this tactic proved effective against green [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], who were often caught up in the heat of battle. The Under Split required at least two [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. In order to execute it, the lead ship shot in front of his wingman, as bait for the attacking fighters. While the attacker turned to follow the foremost fighter, the baited ship's [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] would fly under his leader and cut up, going for a quick belly shot at the attacker.
